scope: MEAS: independent numerical, published bar-map, source/report and visual review; not aural review.

report.finding: The per-piece report matches the recomputed final gates, source, unrepeated order, corrected opening, note/voice counts, 16-page pack and provisional limitations. It retains high regional primary errors and the rejected later opening attack.

barMap.finding: All 8295 note indices resolve, durations are positive, and bar times strictly increase. The five derived intervals have no score attacks and were individually checked against their printed all-orchestra rest measures on pages 2, 4, 10 and 13; they are genuine internal rest bars, not a fabricated endpoint. First and last pages show the actual 1–502 numbering. Listening cues use seconds and agree with the documented repeat omission.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified, including corrected first G near 2.10 s, exposed oboe cadenza, harmonic-worst windows and final two separate chords near 400.46/401.26 s. The short final notated hold is not a measured instrumental release. Acoustic balance does not independently verify every instrumental line.

source.encoder: Stelios Samelis; LilyPond 2.16.2 adaptation by Johannes Heinecke

recordingVersionEvidence.finding: The recording study explicitly documents omission of the exposition repeat and evidence for original orchestral forces, with Stroh reinforcement rather than a generic assumption of bass substitution. It does not identify Nikisch’s physical performing edition.

version.finding: Complete first movement, bars 1–502 once; no exposition repeat. The extended oboe cadenza remains one numbered bar 268. Original source clarinet/horn transpositions are retained and the source’s missing double-bass sounding octave is corrected by −12. Named section voices describe notation rather than separated recorded stems. No gross cut or arrangement mismatch identified.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the B&H source is not claimed as Nikisch’s personal marked score.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. The provisional label and disclosed acoustic/primary-detector limits must remain.
